messages:
people-ops-bot: FYI rachel's birthday is Mon May 18. People Ops poll: 1) In-office grab-and-go lunch 12:30pm 2) Donate $10 to a charity of rachel's choice + virtual card 3) Virtual karaoke (30m) after hours. React with :one:, :two:, or :three: or reply. Deadline Fri noon.
harriet (People Ops): Adding that we can combine 1+2 if majority wants. Also need dietary restrictions and timezone-friendly option for APAC folks.
rachel: omg you remembered!! honestly donation + virtual card would be lovely. i hate the sound of my own singing though ":stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:" so #2 is my top pick.
tom: :three: for morale but if rachel prefers #2 i'm cool with that. could we also do a short in-office coffee table with cupcakes for anyone in-office?
yasmin: :two: — i'd prefer the donation too. if we do cupcakes please GF.
kofi: :two: and i'll cover $20 on top of the team donation. also happy to add a gif and message to the card.
nana: (not on thread earlier) :one: passive, but will join lunch if there's a savory option.
harriet (People Ops): quick logistics: if option 2 wins i'll set up a collective Stripe donation link and a virtual card where folks can add short notes. If combined 1+2, we'll have small individually boxed lunches and still do the donation. Cupcake volunteers: @tom?
tom: I can bring boxes of mini savory pastries. I'll avoid nuts (not sure rachel's prefs).
rachel: no nuts please — allergic to peanuts. also i prefer no balloons (latex allergy).
yasmin: noted GF and nut-free.
harriet (People Ops): signup form: https://forms.gle/rachel-bday-poll — choose option, dietary needs, remote address if you want a care package shipped (we'll do small care packs for folks who opt in). Closing Fri 12:00 PT.
people-ops-bot: Poll results will be posted after closing. Reminder: keep messages brief in the thread to avoid spamming the channel.
kofi: also can we add a small note about the charity? rachel, if you want to nominate a cause pls drop a link.
rachel: thanks!! favorite is CleanOceans.org but open to team picks. happy with a general environmental donation.
harriet (People Ops): noted. will include CleanOceans.org as the primary option and an "team choice" fallback. i'll send calendar invite for the lunch if we go 1+2.
tom: :thumbsup: I'm in to help with setup 12pm that day.
nana: i'll be remote but want to add a message to the virtual card. link?
harriet (People Ops): will DM the card link after poll closes. final reminder: no candles, no balloons, nut-free boxes if requested. thanks all :confetti_ball:
